entries.wording: Parcel information has been received by PARCELPOINT.
entries.note: The carrier booked the parcel to a point; it has not arrived there yet.

entries.wording: [point] has confirmed delivery of your parcel from [carrier], it's ready for collection.
entries.note: The point's name and the delivering carrier's name fill the brackets. The delivery is to the point, not to the recipient.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been collected from the PARCELPOINT location.
entries.note: The recipient collected the parcel; the delivering carrier logs the same collection as its delivery.
